title: Relative final last apex fills a join boundary
statement: Use small simplicial sets, quasicategories and mapping spaces of [def-cbc-enhanced-diagrams-cones], inner fibrations of [def-coef-infinity-fibrations], and ordered joins of [def-coef-infinity-relative-cone]. Let $p:C\to D$ be an inner fibration of quasicategories, let $K$ be a small simplicial set and let $r>0$. Let $a:K\star\partial\Delta^r\to C$ and $b:K\star\Delta^r\to D$ satisfy $pa=b|_{K\star\partial\Delta^r}$. Suppose the already specified last apex $a(r)$ is $p$-final: for every $z\in C$ the induced map $\operatorname{Map}_C(z,a(r))\to\operatorname{Map}_D(pz,pa(r))$ is a weak homotopy equivalence, in the sense of [lem-coef-infinity-relative-initial-boundary]. Then there is $h:K\star\Delta^r\to C$ with $h|_{K\star\partial\Delta^r}=a$ and $ph=b$ exactly. The assertion includes $K=\varnothing$. No dimension-zero lifting or other relative limits are assumed.
